name: batch-record
title: Batch production and movement record
for_each: select id,code from batches order by code

sections.title: Batch
sections.sql: select code,produced_on,abv,source_ref,status from batches where id=$1

sections.title: Analyses
sections.sql: select tested_on,abv,evidence from analyses where batch_id=$1 order by tested_on

sections.title: Movements
sections.sql: select ref,occurred_on,movement,units,litres,litres_alcohol,evidence from v_excise_records where batch=(select code from batches where id=$1) order by occurred_on,ref

name: dispatch-note
title: Dispatch note for review
for_each: select id,code from orders order by code

sections.title: Order and delivery
sections.sql: select o.code,c.name customer,o.status,o.due_on,o.carrier,o.consignment,o.delivered_on,o.tax_basis,o.duty_ref from orders o join contacts c on c.id=o.contact_id where o.id=$1
sections.note: Open orders are planning documents, not proof of dispatch.

sections.title: Batch quantities
sections.sql: select b.code batch,p.name product,ol.units,ol.currency,ol.unit_price from order_lines ol join batches b on b.id=ol.batch_id join products p on p.id=b.product_id where order_id=$1

name: excise-evidence
title: Excise evidence worksheet
for_each: select id,code from locations order by code

sections.title: Location
sections.sql: select code,name,country,licence_ref from locations where id=$1

sections.title: Movement evidence
sections.sql: select * from v_excise_records where location=(select code from locations where id=$1) order by occurred_on,ref
sections.note: Not a tax return. A qualified operator determines classification, exemptions, rates, taxable value and filing obligations.
